title: Echoes of Norms: Investigating Counterspeech Bots’ Influence on Bystanders in Online Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Using simulated online community posts containing gender-based hate speech (e.g., misogynistic comments) as stimuli to evaluate bystander attitudes and behavioral intentions in response to bot-generated counterspeech.

Using simulated online community posts containing race-based hate speech (e.g., targeting immigrants or Asian Americans) as stimuli to evaluate bystander attitudes and behavioral intentions in response to bot-generated counterspeech.
Using simulated online community posts containing region-based hate speech as stimuli to evaluate bystander attitudes and behavioral intentions in response to bot-generated counterspeech.

Using simulated online community posts containing occupation-based hate speech (e.g., stereotypes against nurses or factory workers) as stimuli to evaluate bystander attitudes and behavioral intentions in response to bot-generated counterspeech.
